reply.text:
That's a call about how you feel more than a rule. After a night with no sleep, I'd keep it short and keep it submaximal: no testing maxes, no grinding sets, stay a few reps shy of failure. Your coordination and reaction time are worse, so heavy barbell work is where I'd be most careful.

If you're wrecked, a walk or an easy session beats nothing, and skipping entirely is fine too. Get a proper night's sleep tonight and we'll go hard again tomorrow.

If you want, I can set up something lighter for today. Just tell me how long you've got.
